title: Filler: Rematch with Kiba
later: Rematch later, rookie. You've got something going on. Akamaru can smell it.

offer.speaker: kiba
offer.text: Hey, rookie! Akamaru's been growling at me all day. He says last time didn't count.

offer.speaker: kiba
offer.text: Rematch. Right now. No holding back this time!

dialogue.speaker: kiba
dialogue.text: Gah! Again?! ...Fine. You're good. Akamaru likes you, anyway. Don't let it go to your head.
